description: Factory micronaut — user-facing interface to the micronaut registry. Factory is the attention-field constructor: it creates/evolves the structural materials (micronauts, capabilities, governs, key-store associations, gram geometry) that Yax/GPU attention later resolves over. Factory does not perform attention — it learns and maintains the material attention resolves over. Create/evolve are fully gated: propose_create/propose_evolve return a FactoryCandidate snapshot without touching the registry; commit(candidate, CommitAuthority) writes under XulGate authorization. Phase map: create→Wo, evolve→Yax, propose→Wo, verify→Ch'en, commit→Xul, list/read→Pop, edit/patch→Sek, delete→Xul.

attention_field_role.description: Factory builds the attention-field structures consumed by Yax/GPU attention. Structural learning and attention-prior learning are two distinct jobs that share one Factory instance.
attention_field_role.lifecycle: Experience → Factory → B → Unfold → F_Q → GPU Attention → Yax admission
attention_field_role.invariant: propose_create/evolve never touch reg_ directly; only commit(FactoryCandidate, CommitAuthority) writes to B

ui_card_schema.op: propose_create | propose_evolve | commit | list | read | edit | delete
ui_card_schema.phase: Wo | Yax | Sek | Ch'en | Xul | Pop

read current entry, compute merged snapshot, return FactoryCandidate
advisor verifies+rewrites seed caps via Invoke-AdvisorEvolveQuery; factory_advisor_commit carries the signed-off set

commit_protocol.advisor_evolve_path: Miss → apply_miss_factory_mutation computes seed caps → pending_advisor_verify=true → PS: Invoke-AdvisorEvolveQuery(seed) → advisor rewrites caps → factory_advisor_commit RPC → propose_evolve(advisor_caps) → XulGate → commit
commit_protocol.advisor_fail_closed: Advisor offline or empty delta → factory_advisor_commit not called → no commit; micronaut unchanged
commit_protocol.cap_rewrite: Advisor is a semantic rewriter, not a filter. Synthetic caps (miss::*, needs_fold:*, research_pressure:*) are rejected; advisor authors precise semantic caps

set_laws.no_fabrication: unresolved ≠ automatically needs updating; Advisor determines whether ΔB≠0
